## IRenderMediaKindParams type

`IRenderMediaParams` for one media kind — the per-kind wrappers (`renderPhoto`<!-- -->, `renderVideo`<!-- -->, …) accept this shape and supply `type`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IRenderMediaKindParams<T extends IMediaKind> = IContent & (IRouteMediaAuto<T> | IRouteMediaReply<T> | IRouteMediaBroadcastRevise<T>);
```
**References:** [IContent](./gramstax.icontent.md)<!-- -->, [IRouteMediaAuto](./gramstax.iroutemediaauto.md)<!-- -->, [IRouteMediaReply](./gramstax.iroutemediareply.md)<!-- -->, [IRouteMediaBroadcastRevise](./gramstax.iroutemediabroadcastrevise.md)

## Remarks

The broadcast-SEND route is deliberately EXCLUDED. On that loop `renderMedia` never forwards `params.type` to `_broadcastSendMedia` — the kind is read from the `<g-media>` block — so a wrapper whose whole purpose is to fix the kind would fix nothing: `renderPhoto({broadcast: {ids}})` would send whatever the block holds while the method name said photo. That route is rejected at the type level; use `renderMedia` for it.

The broadcast-REVISE route IS kept, because that loop forwards `type` and therefore honours the wrapper's fixed kind. The kind rides on the content type, so dropping `type` here drops it from every route at once.
